comments.body:
## Implementation complete — awaiting `make verify`

Implemented on branch `fix-34ec-default-docs`, worktree
`.rebar/worktrees/fix-34ec-default-docs`, branched from `origin/main` at `5f618b3ccff` (the
same SHA the plan-review attestation certifies).

Diff is 2 hunks in 1 file, as planned:

- Deleted the `| \`default\` |` front-matter table row (was `:42`).
- Dropped the `default` clause from §4's invariants sentence (was `:201`), keeping the
  `dimension` clause verbatim. Reflowed the paragraph and changed "Invariants" to "The
  invariant" since exactly one now remains.

All 7 locally checkable criteria pass (AC8 `make verify` is running):

| AC | Result |
|---|---|
| AC1 `exactly one default` count 0 | PASS (was 1) |
| AC2 `` exactly one `default` `` count 0 | PASS (was 1) |
| AC3 no `` ^| `default` `` row | PASS |
| AC4 `` no `dimension` `` count 1 | PASS — over-broad deletion would have tripped this |
| AC5 no `^default:` in `reviewers/` | PASS |
| AC6 `index.json` has no per-entry `default` | PASS |
| AC7 exactly 1 changed path | PASS (`docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md`) |

## Residue sweep is now closed

The whole-tree per-symbol sweep that produced this ticket is complete. Regions swept after it
was filed — `.agents/`, `templates/`, `src/rebar/_guides/`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `AGENTS.md`,
`CLAUDE.md`, `README.md`, `docs/adr/` — contain **no** further residue. Two apparent hits were
run down and cleared:

- `docs/adr/0006:104`, `0032:58`, `0061:98` — "default set" in unrelated senses (schema
  defaults, the binary-model default set, the shipped default criteria set).
- `examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md:395` — a `^default:` match that is
  line-wrapped prose about commit conventions ("…the rebar default: a `rebar-ticket: <id>`
  trailer…"), not front matter.

So the complete residue set of the default-reviewer removal is exactly the 2 sites this ticket
fixes, plus 1 site that turned out to be a **separate, pre-existing** defect:

- `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code_quality.md` + its generated mirror `index.json`, whose
  description claims "The default reviewer for the code-review operation." `git log -S` dates
  that sentence to `8bc485c84c2` (story afe6), and it was already wrong then — the code-review
  gate's Pass-1a names `prompt: code-review-base`, and `code-quality` appears nowhere in
  `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/code-review.yaml`. Filed as `polar-alive-wyvern`
  (`dbac-5b59-a614-418d`) rather than folded in here, since it needs an `index.json`
  regeneration and addresses a different concern.

Together this ticket and `polar-alive-wyvern` clear every surviving mention of the retired
default-reviewer concept, which is the bar set for closing `a256-1ae4-cf3d-4711` as superseded.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Epic `87d8-8bb6-5226-4a5b` removed the default-reviewer mechanism. `docs/release-notes.md:85-108`
declares five things removed, and all five are confirmed gone on `origin/main` at `5f618b3ccff`:

- `default` is absent from `FRONT_MATTER_KEYS` (`src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts_frontmatter.py:57-71`,
  which now lists exactly `schema_version, title, description, inputs, outputs, execution_mode,
  category, model, tags, dimension, applies_to, file_impact, langfuse_prompt`).
- `Reviewer.default` and `Prompt.default` are gone from
  `src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompt_model.py`.
- `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json` carries no `default` key on any of its 5 entries.
- The "exactly one `default: true`" index invariant is gone; no test asserts it.
- `select_reviewers` (`src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py:607`) is purely `applies_to`-driven
  and returns `[]` for an empty change set.

**`docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md` was not updated and still documents the removed mechanism
as live, in two places:**

- `:42` — a row in the front-matter key table:
  `| `default`        | Whether this reviewer is in the default set (exactly one default; see §4). |`
- `:201` — §4's stated invariants:
  `Invariants (raised on violation): **exactly one `default`** across reviewers, and **no `dimension` collision**.`

Both predate the epic (`46cdcbe593e`, story 3a8f) and were accurate when written; epic 87d8 is
what made them false. An author following this file would add a `default:` key that nothing
reads — it now parses as an unknown front-matter key (WARN+PRESERVED) — and would expect a
one-default check that no longer runs.

This residue was not caught by `a256-1ae4-cf3d-4711`'s AC1, whose grep covers
`_review_ticket_impl`, `review_workflows`, `ticket-quality`, `ticket_quality`,
`rebar-ticket-quality` and `aggregate_findings`, and never searches for `default`.

## Change

Two edits, both in `docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md`:

1. Delete the whole `default` table row at `:42`. The surrounding rows (`tags`, `dimension`,
   `applies_to`, `langfuse_prompt`) are unaffected.
2. At `:200-202`, drop only the `default` clause from the invariants sentence, leaving
   `Invariants (raised on violation): **no `dimension` collision**.` The `dimension` invariant
   is still live and is the only surviving cross-reviewer rule, per
   `docs/release-notes.md:101-102`, so it must be preserved verbatim.

## Testing

Documentation-only; no code path changes, so the existing suite is unaffected. The criteria
below assert the on-disk text directly. Each target substring was counted on the tree first
and returns exactly 1 before the edit, so none of the "is absent afterwards" criteria can pass
vacuously: `exactly one `default`` = 1, `exactly one default` = 1, `no `dimension`` = 1.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1** `[ "$(grep -cF 'exactly one default' docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md)" -eq 0 ]`
      exits 0. Counted 1 before the edit, so this targets the `:42` row.
- [ ] **AC2** ``[ "$(grep -cF 'exactly one `default`' docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md)" -eq 0 ]``
      exits 0. Counted 1 before the edit, so this targets the `:201` clause.
- [ ] **AC3** ``[ "$(grep -c '^| `default`' docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md)" -eq 0 ]`` exits 0.
- [ ] **AC4** The surviving invariant is intact:
      ``[ "$(grep -cF 'no `dimension`' docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md)" -eq 1 ]`` exits 0.
      Counted 1 before the edit, so this detects an over-broad deletion of the whole sentence.
- [ ] **AC5** `git grep -n "^default:" -- src/rebar/llm/reviewers/` prints nothing, confirming
      the docs were aligned to the code rather than the code having regressed.
- [ ] **AC6** `python -c "import json; d=json.load(open('src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json')); assert not any('default' in v for k,v in d.items() if isinstance(v,dict))"`
      exits 0.
- [ ] **AC7** `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD` lists exactly one path,
      `docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md`.
- [ ] **AC8** `make verify` exits 0.

## Out of scope — checked, not merely unexamined

- **`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code_quality.md:5`** and its generated mirror
  `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json:6`, both reading "The default reviewer for the
  code-review operation." This is a SEPARATE, PRE-EXISTING defect, not residue of the default
  removal: `git log -S` dates the string to `8bc485c84c2` (story afe6), and it was already
  inaccurate then, because the code-review gate
  (`src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/code-review.yaml:68-71`) runs `code-review-base`, not
  `code-quality` — `code-quality` appears nowhere in that gate. Folding it in here would mean
  regenerating `index.json` and widening this slice to a second concern. Filed separately.
- **`docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md:114`, `:126-129`, `:251`, `:256`** — every other use of
  "default" in this file refers to model selection or the `execution_mode` enum default, both
  live. They stay.
- **`docs/release-notes.md:85-108`** — the historical record of the removal. AC-excluded by
  convention and kept verbatim.
- **Re-introducing a default reviewer.** The removal is a shipped, documented decision; this
  ticket aligns the authoring guide with it and does not revisit it.
- **`a256-1ae4-cf3d-4711`'s AC3 and AC4**, which assert the pre-removal behavior. Their
  disposition is tracked on that ticket.

file_impact.reason: delete the default front-matter row at :42 and the one-default invariant clause at :201
